text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Arima Kinen closing in, Agnes Tachyon comes to the realization that the something she's been lacking is a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That same day, she goes running with Manhattan Cafe, and the flames of rivalry begin to kindle within her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After much thought, Agnes Tachyon comes to see her as someone special—as her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later in an interview, Agnes Tachyon expresses her excitement to face off against her rival in the Arima Kinen.
